DataExplorer.PluginDescription: Explore your Matomo data like in GA4 Explorations, or with guarded raw SQL, then save, share and export it.
DataExplorer.ErrorNameInvalid: The report name is required and must be at most %s characters.
DataExplorer.ErrorReportTypeInvalid: The visualization must be a table, an evolution chart or a KPI card.
DataExplorer.ErrorSqlEmpty: The SQL query cannot be empty.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedToken: This query is refused: "%s" is not allowed.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedTable: This query is refused: the table "%s" cannot be read.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedSyntax: This query is refused: it could not be read safely near "%s".
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedParser: This query could not be read near "%1$s": %2$s
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedStatement: This query is refused: only one SELECT query can run, found "%s".
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedTooLong: This query is refused: it is longer than %s bytes.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedTooManySubqueries: This query is refused: it holds more than %s subqueries.
DataExplorer.ErrorTooManyRows: A report accepts at most %s row dimensions.
DataExplorer.ErrorTooManyMetrics: A report accepts at most %s metrics.
DataExplorer.ErrorRowRequired: A table needs at least one row dimension.
DataExplorer.ErrorColumnOnlyForTable: A column (pivot) dimension is only available on tables.
DataExplorer.ErrorRowsOnlyForTable: Evolution charts and KPI cards cannot have row dimensions.
DataExplorer.ErrorKpiCardOneMetric: A KPI card shows exactly one metric.
DataExplorer.ErrorListInvalid: The field %s must be a list of identifiers.
DataExplorer.ErrorPlacementInvalid: Choose all websites or at least one valid website.
DataExplorer.ErrorReportNotPlaced: The report must be placed on at least one website.
DataExplorer.ErrorEditNotAllowed: You are not allowed to edit this report.
DataExplorer.ErrorIncompatibleCombination: The metric %1$s cannot be combined with the dimension %2$s.
DataExplorer.ErrorScopesCannotBeCombined: Action data and conversion data cannot be combined in one exploration.
DataExplorer.ErrorFilterValueNotNumeric: The filter on %s needs a numeric value.
DataExplorer.ErrorQueryTimeout: The exploration took longer than %s seconds. Shorten the period or add filters.

OpenmostCommunication.Matomo6Body: Upgrading now is simpler than catching up in a few months: new features and security improvements land on Matomo 6 first, and we move you there with your reports and tracking intact.
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsTitle: Need help setting up AI chatbot tracking?
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsBody: Openmost can configure AI chatbot tracking for you, on Matomo On-Premise or Cloud.
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsCta: Get it set up for me
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanTitle: Events need to be set up manually
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanBody: Events measure clicks, downloads, form submissions or video plays, once they are tracked. As an official Matomo Implementation Partner, Openmost designs and implements a tracking plan that fits your site.
OpenmostCommunication.EventsEnhancedLink: Get more out of your events with Events Enhanced
OpenmostCommunication.EcommerceEnhancedBody: Ecommerce Enhanced greatly extends Matomo's ecommerce features with new reports on products, brands, promotions, coupons, checkout funnels and buyers. It fits easily into your online store, with no specific development. Free plugin by Openmost.
